sourceChecks.text: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
sourceChecks.textualBasisJa: ツェルヤの子として、ヨアブとアサエルとともに名が挙がります。

sourceChecks.text: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
sourceChecks.textualBasisJa: 1CH 11:20でこの人物名が再び明記される。

sourceChecks.text: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
sourceChecks.textualBasisJa: 1CH 18:12でこの人物名が再び明記される。

sourceChecks.text: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
sourceChecks.textualBasisJa: 1CH 19:11でこの人物名が再び明記される。

sourceChecks.text: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.textualBasisJa: 1CH 19:15でこの人物名が再び明記される。
